title: Reel Cast Charters
specs: Specializes in light spinning gear, live bait, and artificial lures targeting trophy-sized striped bass and other species
Focus on big striped bass in Long Island Sound with no trolling or heavy gear
blurb: Reel Cast Charters offers guided sport fishing trips using light spinning gear, live bait, and artificial lures to target striped bass and other species in Connecticut waters of Long Island Sound. Trips are tailored to anglers of all experience levels and focus on inshore fishing without trolling or heavy gear. The service operates year-round and emphasizes an exciting, hands-on fishing experience.
